% ---- quadratic
\cssec{SPD quadratic and GD}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $f=\tfrac{1}{2}x^\top Qx-b^\top x$, $x^*=Q^{-1}b$, $\kappa=L/\mu$.
  \item $0<\alpha<2/L$; best fixed quadratic step $2/(L+\mu)$.
\end{itemize}

% ---- hb
\cssec{Heavy ball}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $x^+=x-\alpha g(x)+\beta(x-x^-)$; $x_{-1}=x_0$.
  \item $p_\lambda(r)=r^2-(1+\beta-\alpha\lambda)r+\beta$.
  \item For $0\le\beta<1$: $0<\alpha<2(1+\beta)/L$.
  \item $\alpha_*={4\over(\sqrt L+\sqrt\mu)^2}$, $\beta_*=({\sqrt L-\sqrt\mu\over\sqrt L+\sqrt\mu})^2$.
  \item $\rho_*=({\sqrt\kappa-1})/({\sqrt\kappa+1})$. Quadratic result; transient growth is possible.
\end{itemize}

% ---- nag
\cssec{Look-ahead}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $y=x+\beta(x-x^-)$, $x^+=y-\alpha g(y)$.
  \item Gradient at the extrapolated point. A restart discards momentum and retries.
\end{itemize}

% ---- cd
\cssec{Coordinate descent}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $L_i=Q_{ii}$, $x_i^+=x_i-g_i/L_i$. Decrease $g_i^2/(2L_i)$.
  \item Greedy: maximize $|g_i|/\sqrt{L_i}$. Cyclic and uniform random are different selectors.
  \item $d$ updates = one pass. Count the cost of a greedy scan.
\end{itemize}

% ---- cg
\cssec{CG for an SPD system}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $r=b-Ax$, $p=r$ initially. Reuse $q=Ap$.
  \item $\alpha={r^\top r\over p^\top q}$; $x^+=x+\alpha p$, $r^+=r-\alpha q$.
  \item $\beta={(r^+)^\top r^+\over r^\top r}$; $p^+=r^++\beta p$.
  \item $r_i^\top r_j=0$, $p_i^\top Ap_j=0$ in exact arithmetic, $i\ne j$.
  \item Check true $b-Ax$; relative residual uses $\|b\|$ if nonzero.
\end{itemize}

% ---- sgd
\cssec{SGD and variance}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $F=N^{-1}\sum_i\ell_i$, $g_B=|B|^{-1}\sum_{i\in B}\nabla\ell_i$.
  \item Independent draws: $\operatorname{Var}(g_B)=\sigma^2/B$.
  \item Scalar quadratic: $V_\infty={\alpha\sigma^2\over B\mu(2-\alpha\mu)}$, $0<\alpha\mu<2$.
  \item Shuffle each epoch; include and correctly normalize the last short batch.
\end{itemize}

% ---- schedule
\cssec{Schedules and work}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $\alpha_0$, $\alpha_0/\sqrt{1+k}$, $\alpha_0/(1+k)$; $k$ counts updates.
  \item Compare $5$ seeds, the central curve and the quartile interval. Count sample gradients and full-loss logging.
\end{itemize}

% ---- scale
\cssec{Feature scaling}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $Z=(X-m)S^{-1}$, $H_Z=S^{-1}HS^{-1}$.
  \item Original coefficients $w=S^{-1}u$, intercept $b=c-m^\top w$.
  \item Use training statistics. Scaling does not remove correlation.
\end{itemize}

\end{multicols}
